question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Our breathing rate can change almost instantaneously in response to stress or ______.
solution: The correct answer is **"arousal."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Arousal"** refers to a state of heightened physiological or psychological activity, often associated with stress or excitement. (बढ़ी हुई शारीरिक या मनोवैज्ञानिक गतिविधि की स्थिति, जो अक्सर तनाव या उत्तेजना से जुड़ी होती है) • **Example**:* It is well known that thinking angry thoughts can provoke strong physiological **arousal**__.* • Breathing rate can increase or decrease in response to **arousal**, allowing the body to take in more oxygen or conserve it as needed. • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *Our breathing rate can change almost instantaneously in response to stress or __**arousal**__. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "difference,"** means the way that people or things are not the same or the way that somebody/something has changed. (अंतर, भेद, फ़र्क़) • **Option 3, "fund,"** means a sum of money that is collected for a particular purpose. (विशेष उद्देश्‍य से संगृहीत धनराशि; कोष, फंड) • **Option 4, "attention,"** means watching, listening to or thinking about somebody/something carefully. (ध्यान, मनोयोग) 32:T956, The correct answer is **"its long journey."**
